db:select.doc:name: Gmail Status
db:select.db:sql: SELECT a.status, a.external_account, a.granted_scope, to_char(s.watch_expiration AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS"Z"') AS watch_expiration, to_char(s.last_sync_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS"Z"') AS last_sync_at, s.last_sync_status FROM integration_accounts a LEFT JOIN sync_state s ON s.integration_account_id = a.id WHERE a.provider = 'GMAIL' ORDER BY a.created_at DESC LIMIT 1

db:select.doc:name: Dashboard Summary
db:select.db:sql: SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM emails) AS emails_monitored, (SELECT count(*) FROM emails WHERE CAST(received_at AT TIME ZONE 'America/Fortaleza' AS date) = CAST(now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Fortaleza' AS date)) AS received_today, (SELECT count(*) FROM email_classifications WHERE urgency_level IN ('HIGH', 'CRITICAL')) AS important, (SELECT count(*) FROM email_classifications WHERE urgency_level = 'CRITICAL') AS urgent, (SELECT count(*) FROM notifications WHERE status IN ('SENT', 'DELIVERED', 'READ')) AS notifications_sent, (SELECT count(*) FROM notifications WHERE status = 'PENDING') AS notifications_pending, (SELECT count(*) FROM notifications WHERE status = 'FAILED') AS notifications_failed, to_char((SELECT max(last_sync_at) FROM sync_state) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS"Z"') AS last_sync_at

set-payload.value: #[{ emailsMonitored: payload[0].emails_monitored as Number, receivedToday: payload[0].received_today as Number, important: payload[0].important as Number, urgent: payload[0].urgent as Number, notificationsSent: payload[0].notifications_sent as Number, notificationsPending: payload[0].notifications_pending as Number, notificationsFailed: payload[0].notifications_failed as Number, lastSyncAt: payload[0].last_sync_at }]
